Type: implementation task (sub-task of F02.3)
Work key: F02.3.3
Parent: F02.3 (bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27)
Plan: docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md (transition table, public API contract), ADR 003 (recovery)

Scope: public dataset creation in an active primary project (ADR 001 Create dataset), atomic with ExplicitOnly placement and explicit creator stewardship, replacing the operator-only createDataset path for ordinary use.
Acceptance: contributor/steward allowed; reader, lab admin and outsider denied with the uniform 404/403 rule; response-loss retry returns the same dataset; archived project refused.
set.title: F02.3.3: Let project contributors and stewards create datasets
